items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for 25 extensions, including one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (CVE-2026-45247) that allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version 1.11.12.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: The PolyShell vulnerability is a critical flaw in Magento's REST API allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, and execute unauthorized malicious code.
